subject: Discrepancy between Grading Plan C-201 and Utility Plan C-301 on the site retaining wall

messages.text: The site retaining wall shown in Grading Plan C-201 does not match the elevation called out in Utility Plan C-301 near Pour Sequence 4. This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond at your earliest convenience. We can't put a firm date on this ourselves -- it depends on when the survey crew can get back out to re-verify conditions.

Use the elevation shown in Utility Plan C-301 for the site retaining wall at Pour Sequence 4; Grading Plan C-201 will be corrected by addendum. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected.
Resubmitting after field verification: the site retaining wall at Pour Sequence 4 matches Utility Plan C-301 once the survey benchmark is corrected. Please respond at your earliest convenience.
